text:
Looking at the bowl's contents: diced chicken (roughly 80 g), about 12 cherry tomatoes (roughly 70 g), and about 12 kalamata olives (roughly 40 g).

- Chicken: about 80 g × 1.65 kcal/g ≈ 130 kcal
- Tomatoes: about 70 g ≈ 13 kcal
- Olives: about 40 g ≈ 90 kcal

That totals about 190 g and 235 kcal. I added a little for a possible light coating of oil, rounding up to about 240 kcal.
